title: Reverse log-majorization for nonnegative matrix powers
statement:
Let $A,B\geq 0$, and let $p,q,r$ be real parameters satisfying $0<p\leq q$ and $r\geq 0$. Here $\succ_{\log}$ denotes log-majorization. **Reverse log-majorization conjecture.** One has

$$
A^{r+q} B^q \succ_{\log} A^r \left( A^{p/2} B^p A^{p/2} \right)^{q/p}.
$$

This is proposed as a reverse log-majorization statement complementing an earlier result in the paper, and as a route toward the preceding trace conjecture for $s\in[1,2]$. Its status is not resolved in the supplied text.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.05242

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of July 2025).
source_name: Po-Chieh Liu and Hao-Chung Cheng, “On Araki-Type Trace Inequalities”, arXiv:2507.05242 (2025).
